fullDescription.text: 2 reference(s) to ECDSA across 1 file(s), e.g. crates/chain/src/spk_iter.rs:2. Role, judged from paths, function names and nearby code: transaction and message signing. A CRQC derives the private key from a public key that is already known (on chain after the first spend, in reused addresses): funds and approvals controlled by these keys need a migration path. Follow each chain's post-quantum roadmap, avoid public-key reuse, and keep signers ready to add post-quantum signature schemes as chains adopt them. This is a forward-looking risk that depends on the arrival of a cryptographically relevant quantum computer (CRQC). No such computer is publicly known to exist today; the timeline is uncertain. It is not a present-day exploitable vulnerability. Heuristic pattern match on source text without data-flow analysis.
